items.title: Ripple expands Brevan Howard deal with prime brokerage services
items.summary: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing services to funds managed by the $35 billion alternative investment manager.

items.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
items.summary: Sepolia marks one of the final major rehearsals before the final activation of Glamsterdam, aimed at bringing more efficiency and scalability to the Ethereum mainnet.

items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: OKX exchange raises fresh capital at $25B valuation
items.summary: OKX raised an undisclosed amount at a $25 billion valuation as an extension to March's investment round led by the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange.

items.title: Capital starting to rotate back to crypto from AI: Raoul Pal
items.summary: Real Vision founder Raoul Pal says a pause in the AI stock rally could help crypto attract capital, while AI agents are likely to boost Ethereum and Solana adoption.

items.title: US crypto rules need to survive the next election
items.summary: US crypto rules could be vulnerable to political change after the midterms. Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo argues Congress needs to pass durable, bipartisan legislation.

items.title: Flash Loan Attacks Drained $1.2B From DeFi Between 2020 and 2024: Study
items.summary: Attacks grew more sophisticated and less predictable over the period, according to researchers who scanned more than 20 billion transactions.

items.title: Circle, Ripple and Standard Chartered Back OKX at Flat $25B Valuation
items.summary: A London quantitative hedge fund joins the round too, seven months after the NYSE's owner bought in at exactly the same price.

items.title: Morning Minute: The CFTC Reveals Plan to Regulate Crypto Exchanges
items.summary: Clear rules of the road are here. So what does it all mean and what is the overall impact?

items.title: Don Davis Bill Would Fine Candidates $10K for Trading on Their Own Elections
items.summary: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act also gives prediction markets cover to close accounts and report candidates to regulators.

items.title: Crypto 'Godfather' Gets Six Years for Hiring Sheriff's Deputies, $37M Meta Fraud
items.summary: Adam Iza used off-duty LA deputies to pull warrants and personal data on his rivals, then moved the proceeds through crypto custodians.

items.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
items.summary: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

items.title: Solana treasury DeFi Development authorizes CHAD preferred stock buyback program
items.summary: Solana treasury firm DeFi Development approved an open-ended program to repurchase CHAD preferred stock if it trades below its $10 par value.

items.title: Brevan Howard to use Ripple Prime for multi-asset brokerage, clearing and financing
items.summary: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing to Brevan Howard, deepening a tie that began with its Ripple investment.

items.title: Polymarket rolls out V2 upgrade with single ERC-1155 positions contract, pUSD collateral
items.summary: Polymarket rolls out Protocol V2, replacing its legacy Gnosis-based setup with a single ERC-1155 positions contract and pUSD collateral.

items.title: Fortitude expands Zcash mining push with up to $100 million equipment commitment
items.summary: Fortitude secured priority access to BITMAIN's next-generation Zcash miners as it expands capacity and increases financing from DCG.

items.title: Rep. Don Davis introduces bill to stop federal candidates trading prediction market contracts tied to their own elections
items.summary: Don Davis introduced legislation barring federal candidates and their families from trading prediction contracts tied to their own elections.

items.title: Spiko raises $90 million to expand tokenized cash funds across markets
